ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution; high contrast across the entire visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense distribution of dark circular and annular blobs across both lobes; low-intensity clusters are concentrated heavily along the trailing edges and the outer terminal tips, with a high-intensity central field on each lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 65-70 degrees; depth is significant, roughly 20% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth pattern with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; serrations are most jagged and closely spaced on the lateral thirds of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-upward sweep from the median notch to the tips; the trailing edge follows a broadly parabolic arc on each lobe before tapering at the terminal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive mapping of circular and ring-shaped dark pixel clusters (annular scars) ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter; these are distributed globally but show higher density in the distal regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned vertical and diagonal dark linear disruptions visible primarily on the right lobe (viewer's right) and the central-left region, intersecting the white pigment field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular material loss and jagged 'chipping' along the trailing edge boundary; presence of brownish-yellow calcified deposits or bio-fouling clusters at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark horizontal striations and ridge-like textures at the base of the median notch where the fluke joins the peduncle.
